theses.author: Forward Thesis Quant
theses.title: No Actionable Setup Today
theses.thesis: Market structure remains unclear ahead of FOMC. We prefer to stay flat and preserve capital rather than force a trade with unfavorable risk/reward.
support_statements: FOMC meeting tomorrow creates binary event risk that obscures near-term directional signals
Implied volatility elevated across major indices, pricing in significant move
Our edge models show neutral readings with no clear directional bias
Capital preservation is the priority when conviction is low

theses.author: Edge Lab Quant
theses.title: Vol Surface Dislocations Insufficient
theses.thesis: While we observe some term structure steepening in SPX options, the magnitude does not justify deploying capital given current margin requirements and decay characteristics.
support_statements: 25-delta put skew only 2 points above 30-day average — not extreme enough
Front-month/back-month vol spread at 1.8 points vs our 2.5+ threshold for action
Gamma exposure would require 3-day holding period minimum
Better setups likely post-FOMC when vol normalizes
